611:t_020:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ソーラリアン$$ is just a control system. Its power comes from the many feelings you've experienced throughout your battles.」

611:t_020:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ turns them into a highly pure crystal. It's like a battery packed with the power of life.」

611:t_020:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$s $$ＡＧ$$ supplied during $$時空修復|lc$$ in the $$時獄戦役$$... I've kept researching them, and it's finally taken shape.」

611:t_020:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Now there's nothing left to stop us!」

611:t_020:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All that's left is to pit our strength against theirs!」

611:t_020:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Isn't this just what you wanted, General $$ダバラーン$$?」

611:t_020:10.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The battle has merely returned to its starting point... Now we need only demonstrate the Empire's might to the Earthlings.」

611:t_020:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...Exactly! The real battle starts here!」

611:t_020:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$デンゼル$$, $$トビー$$, $$マルグリット$$, $$ツィーネ$$, please provide close escort for $$ソーラリアン$$.」

611:t_020:14.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Roger! We'll protect this ship, humanity's hope, without fail!」

611:t_020:15.en:
$$トビー$$
「That's the deal! Leave $$ソーラリアン$$ to us!」

611:t_020:16.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「You concentrate on attacking!」

611:t_020:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Show me your power, the power that shattered $$クロノ$$'s secret, guarded for hundreds of years.」

611:t_021:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「With the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s power, this $$ソーラリアン$$ can control events once per minute.」

611:t_021:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Six types of event control have been configured, corresponding to the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s GRADE!」

611:t_021:2.en:
$n
「So the higher the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s GRADE, the more types of event control we can use!」

611:t_021:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「It can't do anything too dramatic, but if you use it well, it should expand your tactical options.」

611:t_021:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Understood! We'll make use of that power!」

611:t_022:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「All right, $c! Let's start over!」

611:t_022:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The Chief's played her trump card, too. This really is an all-out battle.」

611:t_022:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's do it! We'll break through here fast and head for the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

611:t_022:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We won't stop! Not until we've liberated Earth!」

611:t_023:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Now no one's left to block our path to $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

611:t_024:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「We also got some reassuring reinforcements ahead of the decisive battle.」

611:t_024:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It's a strange thing to call a bonus, but we've also found a possible way to handle the universe's collapse every 120 million years.」

611:t_024:3.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If the universe's collapse is a type of spacetime disaster, restoring spacetime to a stable state may prevent it.」

611:t_024:4.en:
$$葵$$
「But doesn't that require three keys... three $$特異点|lc$$ individuals?」

611:t_024:7.en:
$$桂$$
「She is the third $$特異点|lc$$, Miss $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$.」

611:t_024:8.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It wasn't something I chose to become.」

611:t_024:9.en:
$$桂$$
「The activation of the $$時空震動弾$$ that triggered the $$大時空震動$$, the origin of today's unstable spacetime...」

611:t_024:10.en:
$$桂$$
「She was there, just like $$オルソン$$ and me.」

611:t_024:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Then could these three restore the world to how it was before the $$大時空震動$$?」

611:t_024:12.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Unfortunately, it isn't that simple.」

611:t_024:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What?! I got my hopes up for nothing!」

611:t_024:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「The current state of the multiverse involves all kinds of factors tangled together.」

611:t_024:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「We probably can't perform $$時空修復|lc$$ unless we find the core of that knot... the so-called $$大特異点|lc$$.」

611:t_024:16.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Isn't that $$ユニウスセブン$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$?」

611:t_024:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「It functioned as the $$大特異点|lc$$ when we repaired the world called $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

611:t_024:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「But to stop a spacetime collapse affecting every parallel world in today's multilayered structure, we need a $$特異点|lc$$ that pierces all worlds...」

611:t_024:19.en:
$$トライア$$
「We'll probably need to find what's called a $$超特異点|lc$$.」

611:t_024:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「At this point, I haven't the faintest idea.」

611:t_024:23.en:
$$桂$$
「But once we find it, the power of the three of us, the $$始原の特異点|lc$$ individuals, should make $$時空修復|lc$$ possible.」

611:t_024:24.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If this supposed great collapse every 120 million years doesn't happen, we won't need to force $$時空修復|lc$$.」

611:t_024:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:26.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:27.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But signs of a mass outbreak of $$バアル$$ have been confirmed.」

611:t_024:28.en:
$$レド$$
「Humanity's battle against them has already begun at the center of the galaxy.」

611:t_024:29.en:
$$レド$$
「And if humanity loses, the universe will...」

611:t_024:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's enough. If you only look ahead, you're bound to trip over what's at your feet.」

611:t_024:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「You pay off a million-G debt by saving one G every day, over and over. Right, $$クロウ$$?」

611:t_024:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But attacking $$ラース・バビロン$$ is too heavy a mission to compare to one G.」

611:t_024:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$, $$バルビエル$$... And on top of them, the power of $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, which we've yet to see...」

611:t_024:35.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We have no idea what emotion powers his $$立ち上がる射手$$ $$スフィア$$, or how powerful it is.」

611:t_024:36.en:
$$メール$$
「But isn't that strange? The Emperor wasn't in a machine during the battle at $$インダストリアル７$$.」

611:t_024:37.en:
$$ランド$$
「It was probably on board $$エルーナルーナ$$'s ship.」

611:t_024:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「All the answers should become clear at $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

611:t_024:39.en:
$n
「And whatever waits for us, we'll keep moving forward.」

611:t_024:40.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Reports of victories for Earth's forces are pouring in from fronts all over the world.」

611:t_024:41.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems the revelation of $$クロノ$$'s doctrine gave people the anger to fight back rather than despair.」

611:t_024:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Humanity isn't as weak as $$フル・フロンタル$$ and $$クロノ$$ think it is.」

611:t_024:43.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's because you... $c... are here.」

611:t_024:45.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's just like the $$時空修復|lc$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$. Your presence brings people's hopes together.」

611:t_024:46.en:
$$トライア$$
「And this world we have now was born by rejecting the $$時の牢獄$$.」

611:t_024:47.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's a world where people wished for a future...」

611:t_024:48.en:
$$シモン$$
「And we're leading the way toward it.」

611:t_024:49.en:
$$號$$
「That's right. We are now humanity's future itself.」

611:t_024:50.en:
$$號$$
「If we lose, we'll close off the future of all humanity.」
